name: Volcanic Escape
text:
Trigger An enemy in your kinetic aura damages you.

---

Lava reflexively explodes underneath you and the creature that hurt you. The triggering enemy takes floor((@actor.level -6/4)+1)d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC. You Leap up to half your Speed in any direction; this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

---

Level (+4) The damage increases by 1d6.
